reels.title: Ego2Act: Evaluating Goal-Directed Manipulation in Egocentric Video Generation

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper explores video generation models acting as world simulators, directly targeting the high-performing 'robotics_tamp' category (1.80x multiplier) while allowing for stunning visual demonstrations of embodied AI physics.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if your AI assistant didn't just 'know' how to move, but could simulate the laws of physics before it ever touched an object?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A professional gymnast mentally rehearsing a routine by visualizing every muscle movement before stepping onto the mat.
